::: {.callout-note}
**Module in progress.** Chapters unlock as they are built; titles below become
links when each chapter lands. Ch1–10 run **in your browser at ₹0**; from Ch11
on you train on a **free Colab/Kaggle GPU** — the handoff chapter walks you
through it, step by step.
:::

One goal for eighteen chapters: **teach the machine to read your handwriting.**
First you build a digit classifier *by hand* — a neuron, then a tiny autograd
engine (micrograd), then a full MLP — entirely in the browser on 8×8 digit
images. Then you rebuild it properly in **PyTorch on MNIST**, on a free GPU.
Backprop's recurring analogy is *the blame game*: every knob learns how much it
contributed to the error.

The compute split **is** the pedagogy: by the time PyTorch hides the machinery,
you will have built every part of it yourself.
